label: Parental leave benefit — monthly ceiling, months 1–3
appliesTo: The ordinary benefit at 100% of ordinary wage. The ceiling steps down to ₩2,000,000 for months 4–6 and ₩1,600,000 from month 7, where the rate also drops to 80%. The parental-sharing and single-parent schemes use different figures.
why: A ceiling, not an entitlement: a worker on ₩3,000,000 receives the ceiling, not their wage. Households plan a year of leave by multiplying salary by twelve and discover the gap after the leave has started.
